outcomes.name: Max Gawn
outcomes.description: Undisputed ruck royalty and a generational skip. You clunk defensive intercept marks in the hole, gut-run from arc to arc until your lungs burn, and put an entire club on your shoulders while keeping everyone laughing.

outcomes.name: Luke Jackson
outcomes.description: A 199cm midfielder trapped in a ruckman's body. You gather your own taps at ground level, snap goals out of congestion like a crumber, and break every traditional big-man rule in the book.

outcomes.name: Brodie Grundy
outcomes.description: The blueprint for the modern clearance beast. You treat every stoppage like a personal turf war, racking up contested possessions, tackles, and follow-up handballs as an extra on-baller.

outcomes.name: Tim English
outcomes.description: Silk over brute force. You hate wrestling in phone-booth stoppages, preferring to drift into space, take uncontested marks on the wing, and hit lace-out targets by foot like a 208cm rover.

outcomes.name: Tristan Xerri
outcomes.description: Pure stoppage violence and second-effort mania. You never lose a physical wrestle, bury opponents in bone-rattling tackles after the tap, and thrive in the nastiest trench warfare.

outcomes.name: Darcy Cameron
outcomes.description: The ultimate utility tall who refuses to lose a one-on-one. Whether floating back to pluck a contested pack mark or sneaking forward to snag a clutch set-shot, you fix whatever is broken.

outcomes.name: Bailey J. Williams
outcomes.description: Undersized by ruck standards, oversized in vertical leap. You launch yourself early at every centre bounce, out-hustle heavier opponents around the ground, and make up for every centimetre with pure mongrel.

outcomes.name: Marc Pittonet
outcomes.description: A zero-nonsense traditionalist built for the centre square. You don't care about uncontested marks on the flank—you just want to body-check your opponent and silver-service hitouts to advantage down your mids' throats.

outcomes.name: Sean Darcy
outcomes.description: An absolute swamp-dwelling unit who clears out the square by sheer mass. Once you plant your frame under the drop of the ball, nobody in the league is shifting you off your line.

outcomes.name: Lloyd Meek
outcomes.description: Bided your time in the twos and emerged as a full-contact battering ram. You love burying opponents into the turf at stoppages and bringing relentless, blue-collar physicality to every contest.

outcomes.name: Mason Cox
outcomes.description: 211cm of pure theatre, tinted prescription sunnies, and unshakeable self-belief. According to Sam McClure, you're a top-three ruckman in the competition—and when the big stage calls, you can still tear a final apart.

outcomes.name: The Ruck Heathen
outcomes.description: You're a blight on the game. A 190cm midfielder forced into the circle to give the real ruck a breather—you don't even jump, you just try to grab it out of mid-air, concede a free kick for blocking, and sprint straight back to the wing.
